title: Yara and the Thorn
author: Edmund Hartwell
blurb: Lena Reyes, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
